title: fix: export sheet back closes the sub-page first

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: export sheet back closes the sub-page first

description: The system back from an export sub-page (e.g. Codec) dismissed the whole sheet and left the owner on the timeline: the sheet's own back handler ran before the BackHandler inside its content. The sub-page state now lives in ExportSheet, the sheet's back-dismiss is off, and one handler closes a sub-page, or hides the sheet from the list. Device-checked: sub-page back -> list; pick -> list; list back -> editor.
changed: fix: export sheet back closes the sub-page first
